ns2:section.sectionText: This section is restricted to graduate students. Restricted to Economics students until the morning of January 13th, 2014. This course explores through film a variety of economic issues that reflect both positive and negative attributes of contemporary and historical capitalism; issues associated with property and class; market failure; healthcare; labor and unionization; capitalism and human obsolescence; market failure; bureaucracy; labor substitutions; finance capitalism; entrepreneurial talent and tenacious individualism. Class meets once weekly for 3 hours to view a film and engage in discussion on its economic content.
